title: 猎物

content_zh:
那矮个子男生还坐在地上, 翻转着自己的配枪, 还深深叹了口气。
连胜问道：“怎么样了？”
“弹匣空了。”男生挠了挠头, “就剩四发子弹了。”
那把枪和连胜的一样, 都是半自动转轮手¨枪。
连胜在他对面蹲下, 伸出了手。
男生疑惑地看着她, 然后想起来说：“哦，对不起，是我连累你了。我没保管好我的枪, 所以害你挨打了。真是不好意思。”
连胜勾勾手指：“四颗子弹，换四只兔子。”
男生听她的话，反应不过来, 光盯着她看, 示意没听明白。直到连胜把绳头交到他手里，才惊得跳起来, 甩手道：“不用不用。这怎么能行？这是你打的兔子！而且四颗子弹怎么能换四只兔子？”
连胜耸肩：“无所谓, 对我来说是等价交换。”
这话真是……太帅了。鲁明远从没听过这么霸气的宣言。
鲁明远却没想着去占一个女生的便宜, 他试探问道：“你是在开玩笑吗？”
连胜嘴角一扯：“我是非常认真的在和你聊天。”
“哦哦哦。”鲁明远挠头, 看后看了眼连胜的胸牌, 说道：“看着也不像开玩笑。我就随便问问。”
连胜问：“你的队友呢？”
“他们在后面。”鲁明远问, “你的呢？”
连胜：“和你相反，他们在前面。”
鲁明远：“……”
反正结果是一样的，他们现在都是单独行动。
“那你可以跟着我走, 我下四发子弹的猎物归你。”连胜又说了一遍, “子弹给我。”
鲁明远犹豫了一下，因为刚才被欺负的事情太让他气愤了。对方就是用类似的理由——我来教你射击——才拿走他的枪的。

他不明白，都是军事学院的学生，为什么要这么恶劣呢？
他低头看了眼手心的子弹，只剩四颗。凭借他自己的水平，在这样的环境里，很难打到一只猎物。连胜如果是骗人的，那结果不会有太大改变。连胜如果是真心的，那或许还有机会拯救他们小队的分数。而且揣测别人的善意，他会觉得很难过。
鲁明远想了想，还是把子弹交到了她的手上。
连胜点点头，再次将绳头递给他：“抵押。”
鲁明远：“额……”
那边，教官将人一路架往医务点，学生不停喊道：“下去了！快下去了！你先让我摸一摸！”
教官坚持道：“这边可能有流弹，野外绝不允许摘下防具！”
学生：“我不摘！你让我自己走！”
教官不耐喝道：“闭嘴！”
好在医务点离得不远，半走半跑的，很快就到了。
教官上前，单手掀开垂帘，带人走了进去。
其实穿上防具，活动会受伤的人并不多，倒是有一些路过的学生，会进来休息一下，喝杯水再走。
终于来了一个疑似病号的学生，医生也很是激动。迅速清出一张病床，让人躺下去。
那学生很是抵触，推开教官的手说：“不用了不用了，借我一个厕所就可以。放开我！”
教官伸手摘下他的头盔，把他按住，瞪道：“你刚才明明那么激动，到底是哪里受伤了？有什么事情非要解防具？”
医生跟着按住：“不要讳疾忌医，说，哪里的问题？”
“胸口。”学生咬牙道，“刚刚有人往我衣服里面扔了一只虫子！”
医生说：“山林里的虫子也是可能有毒的。外面带刺吗？什么大小什么颜色什么种类？知道后果吗？老实躺下！”
那学生听着，迟疑了一下，放弃挣扎。
教官趁机解开他的防具，然后掀起衣服一抖。就见一叶绿色的东西从衣服下面悠悠飘了下来。

医生蹲下来，捡起一片草叶。
那学生丝毫不觉，还在低头查看自己的胸口。
没有，什么也没有！只有草被挤压摩擦，渗透出来的一点绿色汁液而已。
医生面色不善道：“就这个？你是说这个吗？”
学生一愣，当即明白自己是被耍了，又看林医生那即将暴走的表情，支吾道：“我……我不知道。”
医生直接骂道：“你们两个有没有毛病？真觉得这种事情好玩吗？李教官，你这已经不是第一次了，到底是什么意思？带着学生过来凑热闹的？”
那男生从病床上滑了下来，默默走到旁边。
教官嘴角发涩，叫苦不迭。他冤枉的勒。
这是他第二次被林医生骂了。可是他现在都不明白自己究竟做错了什么。他分明什么也没做啊。

content_en:
The short boy was still sitting on the ground, turning over his gun and sighing deeply.
Lian Sheng asked: "How's it going?"
"The magazine is empty." The boy scratched his head, "There are only four bullets left."
That gun was the same as Lian Sheng's, a semi-automatic revolver.
Lian Sheng knelt down opposite him and stretched out his hand.
The boy looked at her doubtfully, then remembered and said, "Oh, I'm sorry, it was me who caused you trouble. I didn't keep my gun safe, so you got beaten. I'm so sorry."
Lian Sheng hooked his fingers: "Four bullets, in exchange for four rabbits."
The boy couldn't react to what she said. He just stared at her, indicating that he didn't understand. It wasn't until Lian Sheng handed the end of the rope to his hand that he jumped up in shock and waved his hands: "No, no, no. How can this be done? This is the rabbit you shot! And how can four bullets be exchanged for four rabbits?"
Lian Sheng shrugged: "It doesn't matter, it's an equal exchange for me."
This is really... so cool. Lu Mingyuan had never heard such a domineering declaration.
Lu Mingyuan didn't think about taking advantage of a girl. He asked tentatively: "Are you kidding?"
Lian Sheng's lips twitched: "I'm chatting with you very seriously."
"Oh oh oh." Lu Mingyuan scratched his head, looked at Lian Sheng's badge, and said, "It doesn't look like a joke. I'm just asking."
Lian Sheng asked: "Where are your teammates?"
"They are behind." Lu Mingyuan asked, "Where are yours?"
Streak: "Contrary to you, they are in front."
Lu Mingyuan: "..."
Anyway, the result is the same, they are all acting alone now.
"Then you can follow me, and the prey I put four bullets on is yours." Lian Sheng said again, "Give me the bullets."
Lu Mingyuan hesitated for a moment, because he was so angry about being bullied just now. The other party used a similar reason - I will teach you how to shoot - to take away his gun.
He didn't understand, they were all students of the military academy, why were they so bad?
He looked down at the bullets in his hand, only four were left. With his own level, it would be difficult to catch a prey in such an environment. If the winning streak is a lie, the results won't change much. If the winning streak is genuine, there might be a chance to save their team's points. And he would feel bad for speculating on other people's good intentions.
Lu Mingyuan thought for a while and handed the bullet to her hand.
Lian Sheng nodded and handed him the rope again: "Mortgage."
Lu Mingyuan: "Uh..."
Over there, the instructor was carrying the person all the way to the medical point. The student kept shouting: "We're going down! We're going down soon! Let me touch it first!"
The instructor insisted: "There may be stray bullets here, and you are never allowed to take off your armor in the wild!"
Student: "I won't pick it! Just let me go by myself!"
The instructor shouted impatiently: "Shut up!"
Fortunately, the medical point is not far away, so I arrived quickly by half walking and half running.
The instructor stepped forward, opened the curtain with one hand, and led the people inside.
In fact, not many people would be injured while wearing protective gear, but some students passing by would come in to take a break and drink a glass of water before leaving.
Finally, a suspected sick student came, and the doctor was very excited. A hospital bed was quickly cleared for someone to lie down on.
The student was very resistant and pushed the instructor's hand away and said, "No, no, no, just lend me a toilet. Let me go!"
The instructor reached out and took off his helmet, held him down, and glared: "You were so excited just now. Where did you get hurt? Why do you have to take off your armor?"
The doctor followed and said, "Don't hide your illness and avoid medical treatment. Say, what's the problem?"
"Chest." The student gritted his teeth, "Someone just threw a bug into my clothes!"
The doctor said: "The bugs in the mountains and forests may also be poisonous. Are there thorns on the outside? What size?"What kind of color? Do you know the consequences? Lie down! "
The student listened, hesitated for a moment, and gave up the struggle.
The instructor took the opportunity to unbutton his armor, then lifted up his clothes and shook them. I saw something green floating down from under my clothes.
The doctor knelt down and picked up a blade of grass.
The student didn't notice it at all and was still looking down at his chest.
No, nothing! There is only a little green juice seeping out from the grass being squeezed and rubbed.
The doctor looked unkind and said, "That's it? Are you talking about this? "
The student was stunned and immediately understood that he had been tricked. Looking at Dr. Lin's expression that was about to go berserk, he hesitated: "I...I don't know. "
The doctor scolded directly: "Is there something wrong with you two? Do you really think this kind of thing is fun? Instructor Li, this is not your first time. What do you mean? Are you bringing students here to join in the fun? "
The boy slipped off the hospital bed and walked to the side silently.
The instructor's mouth became astringent and he kept complaining. He was unjustly accused.
This is the second time he has been scolded by Dr. Lin. But now he doesn't understand what he did wrong. He clearly didn't do anything.
